root_cause: AI model and data-residency edits and connector create/update operations generated canonical cross-domain assessments but the separate CSRD & Impact page did not consume either the tenant's sovereignty review portfolio or pending connector reviews.
prevention: Consume the same authenticated tenant sovereignty readback; never use admin or global scope for customer CSRD dashboards.
Join pending connector CROSS_DOMAIN_CHANGE reviews from the existing tenant-scoped connector review queue; ignore extraction-only and completed reviews.
Project pending CSRD/ESRS scope and materiality reviews into the existing CSRD page without implying a legal obligation, measured emissions, or finished audit.
Keep asynchronous readbacks bound to the active page and latest request revision to avoid stale cross-navigation results.
Keep user-controlled data out of HTML and test ESRS labels against an allowlist.

evidence.outcome: The canonical CSRD view projects pending evidence reviews from both customer AI/data-residency changes and connector configuration changes; a real authenticated customer session remains an independent production test.
